GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

16. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
